comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 asks whether any comment points out an internal logical contradiction or inconsistency among the OP's own premises, or between them and the OP's conclusion. Item 1 asks whether any comment refutes a specific OP example or anecdote, and argues that example is wrong or doesn't support the OP. A comment can do one without the other. The null rules also differ: item 0 is null only if the OP title and argument are both missing, while item 1 is null if the argument is missing.
